proof.source: The physical LTYPE XDATA sequence is bound to the APPID. Each target is independently located by a unique geometric sentinel and bound to its physical section, unique BLOCK_RECORD identity, parsed owner handle, delivered source record and unique live typed LINE. The indexed source collector confirms the ordered source references resolve to model-space ENTITIES and named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS respectively.
proof.output: For each encoding pair, the emitted XDATA sequence is checked against the exact remapped physical LINE handles. The model-space target must be in ENTITIES under *Model_Space; the second target must be in BLOCKS under AuthorityBlock. Fresh typed readback verifies both ordered handles, both owners, both sections through their typed containers, and each target geometry.
proof.failure_retry: For each encoding pair, removing the model-space target and then the named-block target is tested independently. Each removal refuses export and preserves the prior destination; restoring the target allows same-adapter retry with exact output and typed readback. A separate ASCII-input/ASCII-output late mutation changes the named-block target handle after APPID emission; finalization refuses without replacing the destination, and restoring the handle permits a successful same-adapter retry.
